decision_scope: Original NOTEARS method-specific proposal reference choice with a prospective isolated-worker route.

identity.version_limit: Setup declaration only; no fetched release or supported build.
identity.maintenance: Selected commit message is update README; redirect to DAGrad is a lead, not deprecation or comparative evidence.
identity.canonical_boundary: Original xunzheng implementation is distinct from gCastle, DAGMA, CausalNex and other ports.

evidence.anchor: lines 1-201; Apache 2.0 sections 2-4 and 7-9: grant, notices, modifications, warranty and liability text.

target_and_uncertainty: Weighted or norm-valued candidate DAG under selected model restrictions; neither is an effect confidence region.
reason: The original implementation provides a transparent separately pinned comparator. Its numerical/API differences require explicit contracts before adoption; no measured advantage justifies a port.

alternatives.reason: Preserves source semantics while wrapper validates diagnostics, units, topology and errors.
Unpinned environment, hidden optimizer status and distinct nonlinear meaning remain unresolved.
No demonstrated platform/cost benefit offsets numerical and maintenance divergence.
Threshold/constraint/output contracts differ; shared family naming does not transfer evidence.

alternatives.route: Infer signed nonlinear effects from adjacency
alternatives.reason: Identical norms can hide opposite effect signs.
Different sample-law/latent/equivalence-class requirements need their own justification.

costs_to_measure: Upgrade regression and human scientific review

owner_obligations.scientific: Model restrictions, intervention target and sampling law
owner_obligations.maintainer: Environment, conversions, diagnostics and failure denominator
owner_obligations.operator: Distribution notices, custody and future deployment constraints

revisit_trigger: A complete permissible environment, observable diagnostics and matched prospective public/native results justify reconsidering integration; reopen on source, model or platform change.

contract.anchor: Proposed typed conversion and failure semantics

limitations: Thirteen selected original blobs are statically inspected; no downloaded module, CLI, demo or test executed.
Cutoff-filtered default-branch commit and setup version 3.0 do not establish a release artifact, support commitment or native qualification.
Root Apache-2.0 text and wrapper attribution are preserved; full distribution and transitive dependency rights remain unreviewed.
Authored rational and functional examples are proposal references, not observed algorithm failures, empirical accuracy or bank returns.
No latent, temporal, intervention-identification, graph confidence, effect interval or bank-deployment capability is granted.
DAGrad is an upstream README lead only; this decision does not review its code or claim superiority.
Complete software census, Q1/Q5, rendered visual acceptance and final proposal acceptance remain open.
